citation_or_source: Perou CM et al. Molecular portraits of human breast tumours. Nature. 2000.
main_point_supported: Breast tumors show reproducible transcriptional programs supporting molecular subdivision.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Foundational rationale for transcriptional heterogeneity and subtype analysis.
cautions_or_limitations: Predates RNA-seq and PAM50.

citation_or_source: Parker JS et al. Supervised risk predictor of breast cancer based on intrinsic subtypes. J Clin Oncol. 2009.
main_point_supported: Established PAM50 classification of LumA, LumB, HER2-enriched, Basal-like and Normal-like expression patterns.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Core justification for PAM50-stratified interaction and subtype-effect analyses.
cautions_or_limitations: Assignment depends on preprocessing/centering and sample composition.

citation_or_source: Cancer Genome Atlas Network. Comprehensive molecular portraits of human breast tumours. Nature. 2012.
main_point_supported: Confirms major breast-cancer molecular classes across genomic platforms.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports TCGA-BRCA as a molecular-discovery cohort.
cautions_or_limitations: Mostly primary tumors; cross-sectional resource.

citation_or_source: Prat A et al. PAM50 assay and the three-gene model. Breast Cancer Res Treat. 2012.
main_point_supported: Reviews and compares molecular subtype classification.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports keeping gene-expression subtype distinct from IHC surrogates.
cautions_or_limitations: Not direct validation of project estimates.

citation_or_source: Sweeney C et al. Intrinsic subtypes from PAM50 gene expression assay in a population-based breast cancer cohort: differences by age, race, and tumor characteristics. 2014.
main_point_supported: Shows population subtype distributions and imperfect equivalence with clinical marker groups.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports retaining recorded molecular PAM50 labels.
cautions_or_limitations: FFPE RT-qPCR differs from TCGA RNA-seq.

citation_or_source: Kensler KH et al. PAM50 Molecular Intrinsic Subtypes in the Nurses' Health Study Cohorts. 2019.
main_point_supported: PAM50 calls depend on preprocessing; most adjacent tissues were Normal-like.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports distinction between recorded tumor Normal-like and actual normal tissue.
cautions_or_limitations: Adjacent tissue has composition/field effects.

citation_or_source: Elloumi F et al. Systematic bias in genomic classification due to contaminating non-neoplastic tissue in breast tumor samples. 2011.
main_point_supported: Non-neoplastic admixture can bias genomic predictors including PAM50.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports exclusion of recorded PAM50 Normal from formal four-subtype model as a caution.
cautions_or_limitations: Does not prove contamination in specific TCGA samples.

citation_or_source: Aran D et al. Comprehensive analysis of normal adjacent to tumor transcriptomes. Nat Commun. 2017.
main_point_supported: NAT can occupy an intermediate transcriptional state with endothelial/inflammatory alterations.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Caveat for interpreting matched TCGA normal breast as adjacent rather than untouched healthy breast.
cautions_or_limitations: Pan-cancer study.

citation_or_source: Trujillo KA et al. Markers of fibrosis and EMT demonstrate field cancerization in histologically normal tissue adjacent to breast tumors. 2011.
main_point_supported: Adjacent breast can show ECM remodeling, wound healing, fibrosis and EMT-associated changes.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Context for stromal/vascular/ECM signals in normal tissue.
cautions_or_limitations: Small tissue-location study.

citation_or_source: Finak G et al. Gene expression signatures of morphologically normal breast tissue identify basal-like tumors. Breast Cancer Res. 2006.
main_point_supported: Normal epithelium and stroma have distinct profiles; stromal composition matters.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports composition-aware interpretation of normal-side programs.
cautions_or_limitations: Microarray/microdissection differs from bulk TCGA.

citation_or_source: Lun ATL, Chen Y, Smyth GK. It's DE-licious. Methods Mol Biol. 2016.
main_point_supported: Describes filtering, normalization, dispersion and QL testing.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Direct methods support for paired patient-blocked edgeR QL models.
cautions_or_limitations: Methodological source only.

citation_or_source: Chen Y, Lun ATL, Smyth GK. From reads to genes to pathways. F1000Research. 2016.
main_point_supported: Provides end-to-end edgeR QL workflow including complex contrasts and pathways.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports staged filter-normalize-model-test-enrich workflow.
cautions_or_limitations: Tutorial data differ from TCGA.

citation_or_source: Subramanian A et al. Gene set enrichment analysis. PNAS. 2005.
main_point_supported: Establishes GSEA for coordinated pathway shifts in ranked expression data.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Foundational support for ranked GO/Reactome GSEA.
cautions_or_limitations: Sensitive to rank metric and gene-set definitions.

citation_or_source: Wu T et al. clusterProfiler 4.0. Innovation. 2021.
main_point_supported: Documents clusterProfiler enrichment and visualization interfaces.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Software citation for GO/enrichment implementation.
cautions_or_limitations: Version-dependent outputs.

citation_or_source: Gillespie M et al. The Reactome pathway knowledgebase 2022. NAR. 2022.
main_point_supported: Documents Reactome curated pathway resource.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Source justification for Reactome analyses.
cautions_or_limitations: Pathway overlap and redundancy must be handled.

citation_or_source: Ray PS et al. FOXC1 is a potential prognostic biomarker with functional significance in basal-like breast cancer. 2010.
study_or_cohort: Breast tumor cohorts plus functional models
main_point_supported: FOXC1 is elevated in basal-like breast cancer and linked to aggressive phenotypes.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports plausibility of FOXC1 among top PAM50 interaction genes.
cautions_or_limitations: Does not validate exact project effect sizes.

citation_or_source: Jerjees DA et al. Prognostic and biological significance of proliferation and HER2 expression in the luminal class of breast cancer. 2014.
main_point_supported: Proliferation helps distinguish biologically different luminal cancers.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Context for LumB-vs-LumA cell-cycle/proliferation separation.
cautions_or_limitations: Clinical luminal definitions are not identical to PAM50 RNA-seq.

citation_or_source: Cejalvo JM et al. Intrinsic Subtypes and Gene Expression Profiles in Primary and Metastatic Breast Cancer. 2017.
main_point_supported: Intrinsic subtype can change during progression; proliferation/luminal programs shift.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports specimen-specific PAM50 interpretation.
cautions_or_limitations: Primary-metastatic context differs from tumor-normal pairing.

citation_or_source: Liao C et al. Integrated Metabolic Profiling and Transcriptional Analysis... Cancer Res. 2022.
study_or_cohort: Human ER-positive/TNBC tumors plus models; GSE173991
main_point_supported: Independent breast-cancer resource spanning ER-positive, TNBC, normal and PDX samples.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Candidate for focused external marker/direction checks after metadata matching.
cautions_or_limitations: Pairing must be explicitly verified; small and incomplete subtype coverage.

citation_or_source: NCBI GEO GSE173991
main_point_supported: Confirms exact external file structure and processing.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Schema/provenance source for future ingestion.
cautions_or_limitations: Processed matrix is centered/standardized; pairing must not be assumed from names.

citation_or_source: NCBI GEO GSE81540 / SCAN-B superseries
study_or_cohort: 3,678 patients across 405-tumor training and 3,273-tumor validation cohorts; GEO also contains technical-replicate records
design_or_assay: RNA-seq; FPKM/log2; PAM50 available at sample level
main_point_supported: Large population-based breast-cancer RNA-seq resource with PAM50 classifications.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Strong candidate for external subtype-signature validation.
cautions_or_limitations: Tumor-only design cannot reproduce matched tumor-normal interaction.

citation_or_source: Brueffer C et al. The mutational landscape of the SCAN-B real-world primary breast cancer transcriptome. 2020.
main_point_supported: Demonstrates scale and clinical/transcriptomic utility of SCAN-B.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports SCAN-B as mature external tumor-expression ecosystem.
cautions_or_limitations: Focus is mutations, not paired normals.

citation_or_source: NCBI GEO GSE165252 / PERFECT
design_or_assay: HiSeq4000; baseline/on-treatment/resection; processed count and VST matrices
main_point_supported: Establishes staged matrix is esophageal adenocarcinoma, not breast cancer.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Formal evidence for excluding GSE165252 from direct breast-cancer validation.
cautions_or_limitations: Potentially useful only for unrelated cross-cancer exploration.

citation_or_source: Project six-normal sensitivity analysis, 2026.
design_or_assay: Removal of six pre-specified low-PC2 normal pairs
main_point_supported: Primary global, PAM50, pathway and ten-gene results remained highly concordant.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Internal robustness evidence before external validation.
cautions_or_limitations: Internal validation only.

citation_or_source: Chen Y et al. edgeR v4: powerful differential analysis of sequencing data with expanded functionality and improved support for small counts and larger datasets. Nucleic Acids Research. 2025.
design_or_assay: Negative-binomial GLMs and revised quasi-likelihood inference
main_point_supported: edgeR v4 revises small-count quasi-likelihood treatment and implements fitting in C.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Version-specific implementation matters when assessing expression-model or compiler changes.
cautions_or_limitations: Method context only; do not relabel frozen versions or equate the local Efron verifier with edgeR inference.

citation_or_source: Moons KGM et al. PROBAST+AI: an updated quality, risk of bias, and applicability assessment tool for prediction models using regression or artificial intelligence methods. BMJ. 2025.
main_point_supported: PROBAST+AI assesses prediction-model quality, bias and applicability across regression and AI methods.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports a separate R16 gate for population, predictor, outcome and analysis review.
cautions_or_limitations: Guidance is not validation of our exploratory association or computational kernel.

citation_or_source: Collins GS et al. TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods. BMJ. 2024.
main_point_supported: TRIPOD+AI provides reporting guidance for clinical prediction models using regression or machine learning.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Defines transparent reporting if the separate clinical prediction lane becomes eligible.
cautions_or_limitations: Reporting completeness is not model quality or clinical validity; R10 is exploratory association.

citation_or_source: Ji J et al. Multi-regional transcriptomics reveals robust consensus subtypes beyond tumor heterogeneity of breast cancer. Translational Oncology. 2026.
study_or_cohort: Multiple breast-tumor regions and additional public tumor cohorts
design_or_assay: Multi-region transcriptomics and low-heterogeneity NMF classification
main_point_supported: The authors evaluate within-tumor typing discordance and propose classification using lower-heterogeneity expression features.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Motivates specimen representativeness and composition checks for subtype-linked tissue effects.
cautions_or_limitations: Tumor-region comparisons and a new three-class scheme do not replicate our four-PAM50 paired tumor/adjacent-normal interaction.

citation_or_source: Do TTN et al. Multi-transcriptomics predicts clinical outcome in systemically untreated breast cancer patients with extensive follow-up. Breast Cancer Research. 2025.
study_or_cohort: Systemically untreated breast cancer patients with extensive follow-up
design_or_assay: Integrated mRNA, lncRNA and miRNA; outcome prediction with internal resampling
main_point_supported: The study evaluates integrated RNA classes for recurrence prediction in primary tumors without adjuvant systemic therapy.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Treatment context, recurrence endpoint and resampling design inform future clinical transportability requirements.
cautions_or_limitations: Outcome matching is not tumor/normal pairing; internal RNA-model evaluation does not validate our frozen score or overall-mortality endpoint.

citation_or_source: Sparano JA et al. An Artificial Intelligence (AI) model integrating multiscale foundation model histopathology representations with molecular and clinical features predicts early and late distant recurrence in TAILORx. npj Breast Cancer. 2026.
design_or_assay: Clinical, transcriptomic and pathology model; development and institutional holdout
main_point_supported: The study reports distant-recurrence model evaluation using development and separate institutional holdout cohorts.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Illustrates endpoint-specific evaluation and separation of model development from held-out assessment.
cautions_or_limitations: Accepted early article may change before version of record. Within-trial institutional holdout does not validate our tissue score; distant recurrence differs from overall mortality.

citation_or_source: Zhang D et al. Bridging and analytical validation of the Prosigna Breast Risk of Recurrence Test as a whole-transcriptome NGS lab developed test. medRxiv preprint v1. 2026.
study_or_cohort: Surgical resections and core needle biopsies evaluated with Prosigna assays
design_or_assay: Whole-transcriptome NGS laboratory-developed test compared with nCounter
main_point_supported: The preprint reports analytical bridging of Prosigna subtype and recurrence-score measurements across assay platforms.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Informs assay-specific bridging and specimen compatibility requirements.
cautions_or_limitations: PREPRINT version 1, not peer reviewed as reviewed; analytical agreement does not validate our 60-gene score, survival association or paired interaction.

citation_or_source: Iglesia MD et al. Differential chromatin accessibility and transcriptional dynamics define breast cancer subtypes and their lineages. Nature Cancer. 2024.
study_or_cohort: Breast tumors and limited adjacent tissue in multimodal profiling
design_or_assay: Single-cell/nucleus RNA, chromatin accessibility and spatial assays
main_point_supported: The study investigates breast-cancer subtype and lineage programs with cell-resolved expression and chromatin measurements.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports composition and reference-compatibility questions without assigning bulk contrasts to one cell type.
cautions_or_limitations: First online in 2024; retained for relevance, not described as a 2025/2026 publication. Limited adjacent samples and different assays do not replicate bulk paired effects.

citation_or_source: Conesa A et al. A survey of best practices for RNA-seq data analysis. Genome Biology. 2016.
design_or_assay: Review of design, QC, quantification, differential expression, and interpretation
main_point_supported: RNA-seq workflows require explicit design, quality control, normalization, modeling and functional-analysis choices.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Cross-stage audit of TCGA-BRCA count provenance, sample QC, contrasts and downstream biological claims.
cautions_or_limitations: Broad review; not direct validation of TCGA-BRCA effects; published erratum exists.

citation_or_source: Robinson MD, Oshlack A. A scaling normalization method for differential expression analysis of RNA-seq data. Genome Biology. 2010.
main_point_supported: Composition-aware scaling corrects distortions not addressed by raw total-read scaling alone.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Justifies calcNormFactors before normalized CPM EDA and edgeR offset modeling.
cautions_or_limitations: TMM does not resolve biological confounding or all batch effects.

citation_or_source: Love MI et al. RNA-seq workflow: gene-level exploratory analysis and differential expression. Bioconductor workflow. 2019.
design_or_assay: Gene-level count processing, PCA, quality assessment and DESeq2
main_point_supported: Count-derived transformations support EDA while inferential models require unnormalized counts.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Separates CPM/logCPM display and sample QC from frozen edgeR QL inferential inputs.
cautions_or_limitations: DESeq2 demonstration is an alternative workflow; not a prescription to replace edgeR.

citation_or_source: Law CW et al. voom: Precision weights unlock linear model analysis tools for RNA-seq read counts. Genome Biology. 2014.
design_or_assay: Mean-variance modeling of log-counts with observational precision weights
main_point_supported: voom permits limma-based RNA-seq inference using estimated mean-variance weights.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Provides independent model-family comparison option for predeclared sensitivity studies.
cautions_or_limitations: Do not mix voom weights with edgeR QL estimates or relabel frozen fits.

citation_or_source: Huber W et al. Orchestrating high-throughput genomic analysis with Bioconductor. Nature Methods. 2015.
main_point_supported: Bioconductor promotes interoperable data structures, open review and automated package testing.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports disciplined use of Bioconductor containers, version tracking and validated packages.
cautions_or_limitations: Software ecosystem overview is not a benchmark of this project's throughput.

citation_or_source: Robinson MD, McCarthy DJ, Smyth GK. edgeR: a Bioconductor package for differential expression analysis of digital gene expression data. Bioinformatics. 2010.
main_point_supported: edgeR supplies statistical tools for gene-level count-based differential-expression analysis.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Foundational implementation citation for preserved counts, dispersion fitting and testing.
cautions_or_limitations: Historic method paper; version-specific QL inference is separately supported by LM-011, LM-012 and LM-025.

citation_or_source: Köster J, Rahmann S. Snakemake--a scalable bioinformatics workflow engine. Bioinformatics. 2012.
main_point_supported: Snakemake provides reproducible, declarative workflow orchestration across compute environments.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports explicit stage DAGs, checksummed inputs, immutable results and avoiding redundant recomputation.
cautions_or_limitations: Illustrative option; no claim that the project currently uses Snakemake.

citation_or_source: Grüning B et al. Bioconda: sustainable and comprehensive software distribution for the life sciences. Nature Methods. 2018.
main_point_supported: Bioconda distributes bioinformatics software and dependencies through a maintained package ecosystem.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports pinned computational environments and reproducible scientific software deployment.
cautions_or_limitations: Does not by itself guarantee identical numerical results across hardware and runtimes.

citation_or_source: Amezquita RA et al. Orchestrating single-cell analysis with Bioconductor. Nature Methods. 2020.
design_or_assay: Bioconductor single-cell data containers and integrated analytics
main_point_supported: Standardized containers and modular analysis infrastructure help organize high-dimensional assays.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Architectural guidance for future single-cell validation and assay-aware data organization.
cautions_or_limitations: Single-cell methods do not directly validate bulk TCGA-BRCA tumor-normal contrasts.

citation_or_source: Love MI, Huber W, Anders S. Moderated estimation of fold change and dispersion for RNA-seq data with DESeq2. Genome Biology. 2014.
main_point_supported: DESeq2 offers an independently developed count-based modeling framework.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Provides a separate sensitivity-analysis benchmark after design and effect orientation are matched.
cautions_or_limitations: Do not substitute transformed CPM for raw count inference or equate differing estimators.

citation_or_source: Chen Y, Lun ATL, Smyth GK. From reads to genes to pathways: differential expression analysis of RNA-Seq experiments using Rsubread and the edgeR quasi-likelihood pipeline. F1000Research. 2016.
design_or_assay: edgeR filtering, normalization, logCPM visualization, MDS and QL inference
main_point_supported: Distinguishes expression-scale exploration from count-based quasi-likelihood inference.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Supports TMM-normalized CPM/logCPM diagnostic gate and raw-count model separation.
cautions_or_limitations: Already indexed as LM-012; retained as a cross-reference rather than new independent evidence.

citation_or_source: Sandve GK et al. Ten Simple Rules for Reproducible Computational Research. PLOS Computational Biology. 2013.
design_or_assay: Provenance, parameter recording, versioning and automated research workflows
main_point_supported: Traceability requires complete inputs, software versions, parameters and transformations.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Add figure-to-source manifests, seed records, sessionInfo and hashed inputs to R18 outputs.
cautions_or_limitations: General research guidance rather than evidence supporting any biological signal.

citation_or_source: Osborne JM et al. Ten Simple Rules for Effective Computational Research. PLOS Computational Biology. 2014.
design_or_assay: Prototype, testing, reuse and scientific code engineering
main_point_supported: Modular prototypes and testing support more effective and maintainable scientific computation.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Use small typed/checked R functions and profiling before optimization.
cautions_or_limitations: Not an empirical comparison of R function-call speed.

citation_or_source: Ten simple rules for making research software more robust. PLOS Computational Biology. 2017.
design_or_assay: Deterministic tests, usability and robust research software
main_point_supported: Consistency, tested components and reproducibility improve research software reliability.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Require fixture-based tests, stable seeds, parameter capture and reproducible figures.
cautions_or_limitations: Recommendations are software-engineering guidance not an R-specific numerical benchmark.

citation_or_source: Ten simple rules for quick and dirty scientific programming. PLOS Computational Biology. 2021.
main_point_supported: Code development can balance iteration speed with critical reproducibility safeguards.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Prioritize benchmarkable, single-purpose routines and tests ahead of style-only refactoring.
cautions_or_limitations: Not a recommendation to weaken statistical validation or quality gates.

citation_or_source: List M et al. Ten Simple Rules for Developing Usable Software in Computational Biology. PLOS Computational Biology. 2017.
design_or_assay: Usability, interface, packaging and documentation principles
main_point_supported: Scientific tooling benefits from accessible interfaces and clear documented behavior.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Standardize plotting functions and output contracts so analyses can be reviewed repeatedly.
cautions_or_limitations: General usability guidance; not direct proof of any chart's inferential validity.

citation_or_source: Wickham H. ggplot2: Elegant Graphics for Data Analysis. Springer. 2016.
design_or_assay: Grammar of graphics; layered visual encoding
main_point_supported: Layered visual grammars separate data, mappings, statistical transformations and presentation.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Build reusable figure factories with explicit mappings, facets, labeling, output dimensions and themes.
cautions_or_limitations: Book reference; styling alone does not establish scientific accuracy.

citation_or_source: Wickham H. Advanced R. Second edition. Chapman and Hall/CRC. 2019.
design_or_assay: Function design, memory, vectorization, profiling and performance
main_point_supported: Structured functions and profiling enable reasoned computational optimization.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Use base vectorized matrix methods for bulk gene summaries and benchmark specialized helpers before adoption.
cautions_or_limitations: Performance depends on data shape and memory; do not assume vectorization always wins.

citation_or_source: Wilke CO. Fundamentals of Data Visualization. O'Reilly Media. 2019.
design_or_assay: Visual encoding, distribution, color, composition and figure annotation
main_point_supported: Effective scientific graphics require interpretable scales, clear labels, suitable marks and appropriate comparisons.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Define publication-ready figure standards for gene box/jitter, volcano, PCA, heatmaps and confidence interval displays.
cautions_or_limitations: Design guidance does not independently validate biological results.

citation_or_source: Wickham H, Bryan J. R Packages. Second edition. O'Reilly Media. 2023.
design_or_assay: Functions, documentation, tests, dependency management and reusable packages
main_point_supported: Package structure and testing improve maintainability of analytical R code.
relevance_to_current_analysis: Extract stable R18 plotting, validation and CPM helpers into documented reusable functions.
cautions_or_limitations: Book and online manual; package conversion should not delay the frozen model gate.
